choice-cards.$description: Tokens for ChoiceCards: one choice from a few options, drawn as cards (a radio group). Measured from AcmeCo's Language and Region dialog (live site, 2026-10-10). Decision 36.

gap.$description: OBSERVED: about 21px between columns and 15px between rows (160px cards in a 532px area); became 16px both ways.

min-height.$description: OBSERVED: 70px cards (two 24px lines, padding and the border).

border-width.$description: OBSERVED: a 2px border on the selected card and none on the others, so the text moved 2px when selected; every card now keeps a 2px border (transparent unless selected), so nothing moves.

label-font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: the language at 400 over the region at 100; with two weights (decision 4) that becomes 600 over 400, keeping the label the heavier line.

text.$description: OBSERVED: black (#000) for both lines; became ink.

text-disabled.$description: PROPOSED: a choice that isn't available (not observed); the system's disabled grey.

hover.$description: PROPOSED: a grey fill on hover (not observed).

selected.$description: OBSERVED: #dbedff on the selected card; became the system's light blue #cbe5ff (blue.100, the chip's), 14.0:1 with ink.
OBSERVED: 2px #0874e7; became the one link blue #0559b3 (6.80:1 on white), which AcmeCo's other blues fold into.

color.$description: PROPOSED: the system's focus ring, offset outside the card.

font-size.$description: PROPOSED: the group's label, when shown, matches field labels.
